<json>
{
  "states": [
    "Closed",
    "Listen",
    "Request",
    "Respond",
    "PartOpen",
    "Open",
    "CloseReq",
    "Closing",
    "TimeWait"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Closed",
      "event": "send DCCP-Request",
      "action": "open connection",
      "to": "Request"
    },
    {
      "from": "Request",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Response",
      "action": "reply ack",
      "to": "PartOpen"
    },
    {
      "from": "PartOpen",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Ack",
      "action": "open connection",
      "to": "Open"
    },
    {
      "from": "Listen",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Request",
      "action": "reply accept",
      "to": "Respond"
    },
    {
      "from": "Respond",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Ack",
      "action": "open connection",
      "to": "Open"
    },
    {
      "from": "Open",
      "event": "send DCCP-Close",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Closing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Open",
      "event": "send DCCP-CloseReq",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "CloseReq"
    },
    {
      "from": "Closing",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Reset",
      "action": "reset connection",
      "to": "TimeWait"
    },
    {
      "from": "CloseReq",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Reset",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Closed"
    },
    {
      "from": "TimeWait",
      "event": "timeout 2MSL",
      "action": "stop",
      "to": "Closed"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

<json>
{
  "states": ["Stable", "Changing", "Unstable"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Stable",
      "event": "send Change L",
      "action": "set state Changing",
      "to": "Changing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Stable",
      "event": "cond pref_list_changed",
      "action": "set state Unstable",
      "to": "Unstable"
    },
    {
      "from": "Changing",
      "event": "receive Confirm R",
      "action": "set value, set state Stable",
      "to": "Stable"
    },
    {
      "from": "Changing",
      "event": "receive Empty Confirm R",
      "action": "revert value, set state Stable",
      "to": "Stable"
    },
    {
      "from": "Changing",
      "event": "timeout",
      "action": "send Change L",
      "to": "Changing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Changing",
      "event": "cond pref_list_changed",
      "action": "set state Unstable",
      "to": "Unstable"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unstable",
      "event": "send Change L",
      "action": "set state Changing",
      "to": "Changing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unstable",
      "event": "receive Confirm R",
      "action": "set state Stable",
      "to": "Stable"
    },
    {
      "from": "Unstable",
      "event": "receive Change R",
      "action": "set state Stable",
      "to": "Stable"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

<json>
{
  "states": [
    "CLOSED",
    "REQUEST",
    "LISTEN",
    "OPEN"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "LISTEN",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Request",
      "action": "send DCCP-SyncAck",
      "to": "REQUEST"
    },
    {
      "from": "REQUEST",
      "event": "receive DCCP-SyncAck",
      "action": "set sync true",
      "to": "OPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "receive DCCP-Reset",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

<json>
{
  "states": [
    "CLOSED",
    "LISTEN",
    "RESPOND",
    "REQUEST",
    "PARTOPEN",
    "OPEN",
    "CLOSEREQ",
    "CLOSING",
    "TIMEWAIT"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "CLOSED",
      "event": "send Request",
      "action": "set state REQUEST",
      "to": "REQUEST"
    },
    {
      "from": "LISTEN",
      "event": "receive Request",
      "action": "send Response",
      "to": "RESPOND"
    },
    {
      "from": "REQUEST",
      "event": "receive Response",
      "action": "set state PARTOPEN",
      "to": "PARTOPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "RESPOND",
      "event": "receive Ack/DataAck",
      "action": "set state OPEN",
      "to": "OPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "PARTOPEN",
      "event": "receive Packet",
      "action": "set state OPEN",
      "to": "OPEN"
    },
    {
      "from": "RESPOND",
      "event": "timeout 4MSL",
      "action": "send Reset",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "REQUEST",
      "event": "timeout 3min",
      "action": "send Reset",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "cond close_connection",
      "action": "send CloseReq",
      "to": "CLOSEREQ"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "cond close_connection",
      "action": "send Close",
      "to": "CLOSING"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSEREQ",
      "event": "receive Close",
      "action": "send Reset",
      "to": "CLOSED"
    },
    {
      "from": "CLOSING",
      "event": "receive Reset",
      "action": "set state TIMEWAIT",
      "to": "TIMEWAIT"
    },
    {
      "from": "OPEN",
      "event": "receive Reset",
      "action": "set state TIMEWAIT",
      "to": "TIMEWAIT"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
